| Time | Task | What to check |
|---|---|---|
| 0–5 min | First impression | Open the page on desktop. Is it clear what the page offers and what visitors should do next? |
| 5–15 min | Main link | Click the primary button or link. Confirm it opens the intended destination, loads without errors, and matches what the label promises. |
| 15–30 min | Mobile layout | Check on a phone or in a browser’s mobile preview at two screen widths. Look for clipped text, horizontal scrolling, awkward image cropping, and buttons that are hard to tap. Tap the main link again on mobile. |
| 30–40 min | Spelling and copy | Read the page from top to bottom, including buttons and footer text. Check spelling, punctuation, and consistency in names and capitalization. |
| 40–45 min | Summarize findings | For each issue, note where it appears, what you expected, and what happened. Flag broken links and anything that blocks mobile use as top priorities. |
